title: workflow speed: a hermetic test run never starts the cache server from its throwaway TMP
goal: sccache's client starts a server when none runs and that server keeps the client's environment; one started by the first cargo of a hermetic run kept the run's deleted TMP and failed every compile on the machine. check-hermetic-tests.sh starts the server from the real environment before it switches TMP, through one ensure-server mode of setup-sccache.sh that knows the config block.
